title: Runtime-tile referential integrity in static validation

defect_summary.unchecked_controller_refs: validate_runtime_tile never inspected <controller> elements. A controller clone left behind a signal pruned from its road (or a controller copied from the source) declared a control/signalId that does not exist in the tile, yet validation returned PASS.
defect_summary.unchecked_lane_link_targets: Junction connection <laneLink from> / <laneLink to> were never resolved against the declared left/right lane ids of the referenced incoming/connecting roads. A from/to referencing a lane id that does not exist is a CARLA load-time crash source and validation did not notice.
defect_summary.duplicate_ids_silent: Duplicate road or junction ids (which make every road/junction reference ambiguous) were acceptable. Duplicate signal ids were likewise unreported.

corrected_semantics.dangling_controller_refs: Each controller's control/signalId must exist among the tile's <signal> ids; a missing id adds the failure and a detail row {controller_id, signal_id}.
corrected_semantics.invalid_connection_lane_links: For every junction connection, each <laneLink> from must be a lane id of the incomingRoad and each to must be a lane id of the connectingRoad (left/right lanes; center lane id=0, type none, is never a legal link target). A missing from/to attribute is tolerated; a mismatch adds one detail row {junction_id, connection_id, incomingRoad, connectingRoad, from, to}.
corrected_semantics.duplicate_element_ids: Duplicate road or junction ids now fail. Duplicate signal ids are reported in the report (duplicate_signal_ids) but do not fail the tile, preserving compat while surfacing ambiguity for controller resolution.
corrected_semantics.build_runtime_tile: Keeps delete-on-fail: a tile failing any of the new families is unlinked and a RuntimeError with the failing codes is raised.

coverage.B: invalid_connection_lane_links fails when to references a missing lane id
coverage.C: from referencing a missing lane id fails
coverage.D: duplicate road and junction ids fail with duplicate_element_ids
coverage.D2: duplicate signal ids are reported but do not fail
coverage.E: build_runtime_tile rejects broken lane-link source, emits nothing
coverage.F: build_runtime_tile passes a well-formed referential tile with controller + valid laneLinks
coverage.G: clean tile reports empty new summary fields on PASS

residual_risks: Lane-link validation is existence-based (a legal lane id that is nonetheless unreachable in CARLA's successor/pruning semantics is not caught); directional/sign consistency is left to topology-level audits.
Duplicate signal ids are informational only; a fully strict identity policy would fail them, which was deferred to avoid false failures on legacy maps.
Junction <connection>-level geometry (contactPoint semantics, lane reachability through connectors) is out of scope for static referential validation.
